title: Top Summer Beauty and Travel Essentials for Every Kind of Getaway - NewsBreak
text: WET Swimwear Thalia Tie-Shoulder One-Piece, $128 Designed and made in Los Angeles, this flattering red and pink swimsuit is equal parts comfort and playfulness. Think generous coverage, fully lined and UPF 50+ sun protection. wet-swimwear.com Tower 28 SOS FaceGuard Broad Spectrum SPF 30, $32 This creamy, lightweight mineral sunscreen protects against UVA and UVB rays with no white cast and no orange tint. It’s ophthalmologist-approved and even passed a sauna test, with zero stinging even if you sweat. tower28beauty.com White + Warren Cashmere Travel Wrap, $350 Made of seven feet of responsibly sourced Mongolian cashmere, this 7-gauge knit, jersey weight wrap has been a fan favorite for two decades and counting. Available in dozens of colors, it’s incredibly warm yet light for flights and easily doubles as a chic evening wrap. whiteandwarren.com Kuru Footwear, ATOM 2 Sneaker, $169 Whether you’re chasing waterfalls or wandering through museums, these heel-hugging sneakers (initially created for relief for plantar fasciitis) are all about support, breathability and flexibility. Lightweight, available in multiple widths and colors. kurufootwear.com Cozy Earth Windowpane Resort towels, $80 Oversized and quick-drying, these recently launched windowpane patterned towels feature zero-twist fibers that allow for plushness and absorbency. The fun, reversible pastel hues are perfect for summer. cozyearth.com Tom Bihn Synik 30 backpack, $345 This bestselling travel backpack has all the bells and whistles, including multiple exterior pockets, sternum strap, waist strap, laptop compartment and rolling luggage handle passthrough. Everything from design to cutting to sewing happens at the company headquarters in Seattle. tombihn.com
